sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for chart and demo checks
sections.what: Loads the chart, cohort, review and demo modules, plus the database connection and the assert helper.
sections.why: Gives the test access to every module it checks.
sections.watch_out: The imports reach into a sibling library folder, so moving files breaks them.

sections.name: make
sections.title: Sample project builder
sections.what: Builds a sample nuclear project with default values. Individual tests change some of these values.
sections.why: Keeps each test short by sharing one sample shape.
sections.watch_out: Any change to a default value changes every test that uses it.

sections.name: rows
sections.title: Sample project set and basic checks
sections.what: Builds five sample projects with deliberate gaps, such as missing capacity, a wrong unit and a zero delay, then checks counts, filters, sizing and slide content.
sections.why: Includes messy cases so the tests cover realistic data.
sections.watch_out: The expected numbers depend on these exact sample values.

sections.name: extremes (part 1)
sections.title: Extreme values and date notes
sections.what: Tests very large and very small values, checking that bubbles stay inside the plot and do not cover text. Also checks calculated end-date notes and the synthesis slides, and starts the database section.
sections.why: Likely reason: extreme numbers can push chart elements off the page or over each other.
sections.watch_out: The plot boundary numbers are fixed, so a layout change will break this test.

sections.name: extremes: for
sections.title: Pinned demo checks
sections.what: Checks both pinned demos against the expected project set and Yard values, then checks scan coverage for delivery and portfolio views and confirms the mixed-units reason is shown. Closes the database connection at the end.
sections.why: Confirms the saved demos still show the agreed numbers.
sections.watch_out: Expected values such as 191 and 0 plotted must be re-measured when the data changes, as the failure messages say.

summary: A test file that checks chart, scan and synthesis logic with fixture data, then confirms the pinned LNG demos still match the database.
purpose: Catches changes that would silently alter the numbers and charts shown in the demo decks.
why: Likely reason: the demos replay saved runs, so any drift in data or logic would show a viewer wrong results.
how: First checks chart, filter and sizing logic using a few small sample projects. Then checks bubble placement and labels for extreme values, date notes, and synthesis slides. Last, connects to the database and confirms that the two pinned demo runs still match the expected LNG project set and coverage numbers.
inputs: Sample project objects written in the file, the scan template, cohort, review and deck modules, and the live database for the final part.
outputs: Console PASS lines, or an assertion error that stops the run. The database connection is closed at the end.
risks: The final part needs a working database and hardcoded counts of 191 projects. It can fail when real data changes even if the code is correct.
debug: Read the failure message: it names the demo tool and the problem. If a fixture check fails, the chart or filter logic changed, so check the matching library module. If a pin check fails, re-measure the pin as the message says.
